entries.en: Not even close...! I am extremely bored... Why...?
entries.ro: Nici pe departe...! Mă plictisesc de moarte... De ce...?

entries.en: Maybe a braindance in the evening...? Well, do you have a better.
entries.ro: Poate un braindance diseară...? Sau ai ceva mai bun?

entries.en: No, no, no! Don't hurt me!
entries.ro: Nu, nu, nu! Nu mă răni!

entries.en: I'll forget I ever saw you!
entries.ro: O să uit că te-am văzut vreodată!

entries.en: Do you think this is funny?
Um, what else...?! I would rather do nothing.
entries.ro: Um, ce altceva...?! Aș prefera să nu fac nimic.

entries.en: You don't say... Mhm... I'm sold!

entries.ro: Tu... Pleci pur și simplu? OK...

entries.en: Can we continue our discussion, huh?
